title: Remote vs. In-Person Study Evaluation (RISE) Trials: RISE Above Opioid Overdose (Trial 3 of 3)
official: Remote vs. In-Person Study Evaluation (RISE) Above Opioid Overdose
summary: The study will employ a randomized, parallel-group design with two-stage randomization. After an initial brief screen for basic eligibility, participants will be randomized (within site) to either Remote (R) or In-Person (IP) Intake Groups. During the Intake, detailed consent and eligibility assessment will be completed. Participants who are eligible at the Intake will be randomized (within site and Intake Group) to R or IP Treatment and Assessment Groups. Participants will be followed for 3 months.
criteria:
INCLUSION CRITERIA:

Common to all 3 RCTs:

1. age18+ years
2. stable mailing address (for mailing study packets if assigned to Remote Intake and/or Remote Treatment/Assessment) within accessible range (1.5 hours) of each study site (per self report)
3. able to read, speak \& verbally comprehend English
4. currently own an iOS- or Android-compatible smartphone
5. have a valid e-mail address that is checked regularly (at least once per day) or have regular access to text messages (to access follow-up assessments)

Specific to RCT 3:

e) Meet criteria for Opioid Use Disorder and/or Stimulant Use Disorder (moderate or severe) on the DSM-5 Checklist and who report using either non-prescribed opioids (e.g., heroin, opioid pills) or stimulants (e.g., cocaine, methamphetamine) at least once in the past 3 months.

EXCLUSION CRITERIA:

Common to All 3 RCTs:

1. consumption of \>28 alcohol-containing drinks per week
2. suicide attempt with at least some wish to die in past 3 months
3. mental illness (such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or major depression) that led to hospitalization in the past 30 days
4. unable/unwilling to provide informed consent or follow directions, inappropriately responsive, based on staff observations

   Specific to RCT3:
5. None.
sponsor: State University of New York at Buffalo
